# Checkbox

Toggle one optional value or represent a partially selected parent.

## Examples

### Binary

Represent one optional value with ordinary checked and unchecked states.

<ComponentExample component="checkbox" scenario="binary" title="Binary" description="Represent one optional value with ordinary checked and unchecked states." :index="0" />

### Mixed

Represent a parent whose child values are only partly selected.

<ComponentExample component="checkbox" scenario="mixed" title="Mixed" description="Represent a parent whose child values are only partly selected." :index="1" />

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Space</kbd> | Toggle the current value. |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move through the normal document focus order. |

## Accessibility

The root exposes checkbox semantics, including the mixed value through `aria-checked="mixed"`.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/checkbox/) for the host accessibility contract.
